scope.included: fak_adjudicate outcome receipt, adversarial non-execution and non-leakage invariants, discovery/schema semantics, and direct k.Decide equal-fixture baseline
scope.excluded: fak_syscall execution, vDSO execution, result admission quarantine, and plugin tracing

contract.compatibility: legacy verdict, trace_id, and repaired_arguments fields are preserved; repaired_arguments appears only on TRANSFORM
contract.sanitized_error: malformed inputs return sanitized error code and source without leaking paths, secrets, or raw arguments

cases: transformed outcome mapping from TRANSFORM with repaired_arguments
default-deny outcome mapping from unknown tool
sanitized failure contract on missing tool name
secret and path non-leakage in error receipts
discovery tool descriptor documentation and non-execution contract

limitations: The MCP benchmark includes JSON-RPC decoding, argument validation, trace allocation, receipt synthesis, and JSON response formatting; direct k.Decide measures only in-kernel policy adjudication without transport overhead.
These measurements are a local baseline; no speedup is claimed for the MCP layer, and the mediation overhead is recorded honestly.
